# Raft Host Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

## Tech Design

- [Tech Design](tech-design): implementation source of truth.

## Capability Map

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project raft-host`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project raft-host`.
- Blockers: `aw health --project raft-host blockers`.

## Commands

- Test: `cargo test -p raft-host`.
